drugs.mechanism_cn: 重组人角质细胞生长因子-1（KGF-1）；促进上皮增殖、迁移与分化
drugs.mechanism_en: Recombinant human KGF-1; promotes epithelial proliferation, migration and differentiation
drugs.notes_cn: 唯一获FDA批准的OM药物。血液肿瘤干细胞移植场景：WHO 3/4级OM发生率63% vs 98%，中位持续时间3天 vs 9天。头颈癌放疗场景未复制成功。
drugs.notes_en: The only FDA-approved OM drug. In HSCT setting: Grade 3/4 OM incidence 63% vs 98%, median duration 3 vs 9 days. Failed to replicate in head & neck radiotherapy setting.

drugs.mechanism_cn: 口服重组乳酸乳球菌，分泌人三叶因子1（hTFF1），促进黏膜修复
drugs.mechanism_en: Oral recombinant Lactococcus lactis secreting hTFF1; promotes mucosal repair
drugs.notes_en: Phase Ib: 35% reduction in UOM days. Phase II status: Terminated.

drugs.mechanism_cn: 选择性超氧化物歧化酶模拟物；清除放疗产生的超氧阴离子自由基
drugs.mechanism_en: Selective SOD mimetic; scavenges superoxide radicals from radiotherapy
drugs.notes_cn: ROMAN试验：严重OM发生率64%→54%，中位持续时间18天→8天。FDA认为不足以支撑实质性证据。
drugs.notes_en: ROMAN: Severe OM incidence 64%→54%, median duration 18→8 days. FDA deemed insufficient for substantial evidence.

drugs.mechanism_cn: 先天免疫调节剂；调节巨噬细胞反应，加速炎症消退
drugs.mechanism_en: Innate immune modulator; regulates macrophage response to accelerate inflammation resolution
drugs.notes_cn: III期（n=266）：SOM中位持续时间12.5天 vs 20.0天，未达统计学显著性门槛。
drugs.notes_en: Phase III (n=266): Median SOM duration 12.5 vs 20.0 days, failed to reach statistical significance.

drugs.mechanism_cn: 先天免疫应答调节剂；具体靶点仍在阐明
drugs.mechanism_en: Innate immune response modulator; specific target under elucidation
drugs.notes_cn: 放疗≥55 Gy患者中，有效降低SOM持续时间、发作时间和发生率，延迟阿片类药物使用。
drugs.notes_en: In patients receiving ≥55 Gy, effectively reduced SOM duration, onset, and incidence; delayed opioid use.

drugs.mechanism_cn: NLRP3炎症小体抑制剂 + Nrf2激活剂；缺氧条件下释放NO
drugs.mechanism_en: NLRP3 inflammasome inhibitor + Nrf2 activator; releases NO under hypoxia
drugs.notes_cn: 头颈癌CRT：Arm 1组SOM中位持续时间8.5天 vs 24天。二次分析提示可能减少多种CRT相关毒性。
drugs.notes_en: H&N CRT: Arm 1 median SOM duration 8.5 vs 24 days. Secondary analysis suggests possible reduction of multiple CRT-related toxicities.

drugs.mechanism_cn: 黏膜保护剂；COX-2依赖PGE2合成、EGF/HGF上调、清除自由基、抑制IL-1/IL-8/TNF-α
drugs.mechanism_en: Mucosal protectant; COX-2-dependent PGE2 synthesis, EGF/HGF upregulation, free radical scavenging, IL-1/IL-8/TNF-α inhibition
drugs.notes_cn: 2019荟萃分析：含漱预防放化疗OM优于安慰剂。正在进行的III期与盐酸苄达明含漱头对头比较。
drugs.notes_en: 2019 meta-analysis: mouthwash superior to placebo for OM prevention. Ongoing Phase III head-to-head vs benzydamine.

drugs.notes_cn: 首个RIOM中药随机双盲试验：低剂量组严重OM发生率22.2%，安慰剂组43.7%（P=0.0042）。
drugs.notes_en: First RCT of TCM for RIOM: Severe OM incidence 22.2% (low dose) vs 43.7% (placebo), P=0.0042.

drugs.mechanism_cn: 抑制COX-2、中性粒细胞趋化；清除羟自由基
drugs.mechanism_en: COX-2 and neutrophil chemotaxis inhibition; hydroxyl radical scavenging
drugs.notes_cn: 仓鼠模型：严重黏膜炎发生率从100%降至16.7%（P<0.05）。
drugs.notes_en: Hamster model: Severe mucositis incidence reduced from 100% to 16.7% (P<0.05).

drugs.mechanism_cn: 标准化植物提取物复方
drugs.notes_cn: 一项RCT（n=116）：未显著降低严重RIOM，但生活质量显著更好。另一小型研究（n=30）报告可显著降低RIOM严重程度。
drugs.notes_en: One RCT (n=116): No significant reduction in severe RIOM, but QoL significantly better. Another small study (n=30) reported significant reduction.

drugs.mechanism_cn: 免疫调节与组织修复；促进上皮增殖、增强固有免疫
drugs.mechanism_en: Immune modulation and tissue repair; promotes epithelial proliferation and innate immunity
drugs.notes_cn: 历史数据不一致，更严格RCT未优于安慰剂。探索性分析提示基线活化CD4+ T细胞比例可能预测黏膜易感性。
drugs.notes_en: Inconsistent historical data; stricter RCTs did not show superiority over placebo. Exploratory analysis suggests baseline activated CD4+ T cell ratio may predict mucosal susceptibility.

drugs.mechanism_cn: 激活SIRT2，促进同源重组介导的DNA双链断裂修复，保护口腔黏膜干细胞
drugs.mechanism_en: Activates SIRT2; promotes homologous recombination-mediated DSB repair; protects oral mucosal stem cells
drugs.notes_cn: 小鼠模型：保护免于RIOM，不损害癌细胞放疗敏感性。
drugs.notes_en: Mouse model: Protects against RIOM without compromising cancer radiosensitivity.

drugs.mechanism_cn: 局部递送氯喹+黄芩素纳米粒；阻断TFRC介导的铁摄取，抑制铁死亡
drugs.mechanism_en: Local delivery of chloroquine + baicalein nanoparticles; blocks TFRC-mediated iron uptake, inhibits ferroptosis
drugs.notes_cn: 大鼠模型：显著减轻溃疡、加速愈合，机制涉及抗炎、血管生成和胶原沉积。
drugs.notes_en: Rat model: Significantly reduces ulcers and accelerates healing; mechanisms involve anti-inflammation, angiogenesis, and collagen deposition.

drugs.mechanism_cn: 调节氧化应激、炎症介质与细胞修复信号
drugs.mechanism_en: Modulates oxidative stress, inflammatory mediators, and cell repair signaling
drugs.notes_cn: PBM组口腔疼痛评分维持在<4。
drugs.notes_en: PBM group oral pain scores maintained at <4.
